m: A **white dove** flies straight out of the *sun*, and its little *slide* on top is the tail feather it trails behind.
Tuck a single *drop* of soup under a cosy *blanket* to keep it warm, and the blanket curls into a **ladle**.
Lay a *plank* across a wide-open *mouth* and it glows hot and bright: you have swallowed the **sun**.
A fortune teller drops a *pole* in the dirt and reads the single *drop* of ink beside it: a **fortune stick**.
Under a stone *archway* hang *two planks* that glow pale at night, the way the **moon** hangs in the sky.
A *helping hand* reaches up, and a *slide* of a thumb on top makes it a whole **hand** waving at you.
Swing a *scythe*, nail a *plank* across it, add a *slide* of a blade and a *drop* of red tassel: a soldier's **halberd**.
A *slide* leans against a *pole* like a tired man waiting for a bus: a **standing person**.
A *ski* curls its tip up and over like a stinging tail, and the ski turns into a **scorpion**.
A *long sweep* of the brush stretches out flat and winding, like a dusty **road** heading off to the horizon.
Lift the *lid* off the ink pot and cross the *scissors* over your arm to cut in a **tattoo**.
Two *slides* lean on each other, legs apart, holding each other up: that is a walking **person**.
A single *bracket* stands tall on the street with a gap you can walk through: the old town **gate**.
A young *tree* gets a short *plank* tied across its top to keep it straight while the **sapling** grows.
Bend your arm into a *bracket* and lash out with a *slash* of a fist: that is a **strong arm**.
A *slide* of drooping seed head hangs off the top of a *tree*-like stem: a heavy **grain stalk**.
Close the open *archway* with a *plank* along the bottom and nothing can get out of the **fence**.
A *king* keeps one precious green *drop* tucked beside his belt: a **jade gem**.
Plant a *cross* firmly on a *plank* of ground and you are marking out your patch of **soil**.
An *arrowhead* drops from the sky and sticks in the *soil*: the spot of the **arrow landing**.
Hang a *fish hook* beside a tall *pole* and the pair stands upright, sharp and ready: a **standing knife**.
A single *drop* of a word floats beside someone's head inside a **small speech bubble**.
A *slash* and a *ski* stride off in different directions, like two **legs** walking away.
Press a *drop* of ink onto a short hand and you leave the print of your **thumb**.
A *zigzag* of a skirt sways under a flat *awning* as a **woman** steps into the shade.
A *fish hook* scrapes the table and the *curtains* catch the little **crumbs** that fly off either side.
Hop along on a *crutch* and a *drop* of skin pops up on your hand: an ugly little **wart**.
Push a tall *pole* up through the middle of a *pit* and the earth rises into three peaks: a **mountain**.
Lay one *plank* above another *plank* and you have **two planks**, easy to count.
Bend your arm into a *zigzag* and a *drop* of a bump sticks out: your bony **elbow**.
Drive a *fish hook* down through a *plank* and its flat head holds tight like a **nail**.
Throw a *boomerang* with a quick *sweep* of the wrist, and it comes back to your **right hand**.
Wrap a *boomerang* blanket around a baby and tie it off with a *fish hook*: a **swaddled baby**.
A row of short marks beside a *pole* show where someone walked past: **footsteps**.
The *sun* lifts itself just above the flat *plank* of the horizon: **sunrise**.
Lay a *plank* over a *cross* and hang your wet socks on it: a **drying rack**.
A pair of curly *horns* on top of a woolly body: that is a **sheep**.
Stretch a *mouth* tall and lay *two planks* inside it as lashes: now it is an **eye**.
A *king* sits still while a *drop* of flame burns above his crown, like a **candle**.
Lay a *plank* across a *pole* and they meet in the middle: a **cross**.
A wide *archway* with *soil* inside, split into four squares: a flooded **rice field**.
A pair of *antlers* stands on top of a big *nose*: that is the stag's **head**.
Stand on *two planks* and hop off with a *fish hook* of a toe: one **single footstep**.
A *leaning cliff* tilts over a doorway, its hinges creaking: a weathered **old door**.
Swing a blade at a *leaning cliff* until it splits open a *trapdoor*: the work of an **axe**.
A *big man* walks along with a *drop* of a nose sniffing at his side: his faithful **dog**.
A *drop*, a *drop*, a *drop* and one last *drop* glow red under the cooking pot: the fire's **embers**.
Throw a *cloth cover* over your house and stick a *drop* of chimney on top: a **roof**.
A fat *plank* of a body on short legs, snout down in the mud: a **pig**.
Shoot a *pole* straight through the middle of a *mouth*: a perfect **bullseye**.
A single *plank* lies on the ground, and a buzzing **swarm** of bees pours out from under it.
Put a *drop* of a knob on top of a flat *plank* and you can lift it off like a **lid**.
A short *plank* of a spindle with fibre twisting round it: a strand of **silk thread**.
Flick *two sparks* off your wet fingers and a third falls too: little **water drops**.
Unwrap a *swaddled baby*, stretch its arms along a *plank*, and you have a little **child**.
Stand on the *soil*, raise a golden *plank* above your head, and you rule as **king**.
Under an *archway* stand two long *legs* topped by a big eye: the **watcher**.
A *shelf bracket* with *two planks* sticking out sideways like teeth: a **comb**.
Grab a *small table* by one leg with your *right hand* and swing it like a **war club**.
Kick up *soil* with a twist of your *ankle* as you sprint away: a **runner**.
A *ski* bends back on itself twice and lies coiled on the deck like a **coiled rope**.
A *person* stretches both arms wide along a *plank*, as big as he can be: a **big man**.
A *slide* to the left and a *slide* to the right pull apart like **curtains** opening.
A *bracket* of a handle and a *slash* of a blade: together they make a **knife**.
Lift the *lid* and a pair of *antlers* pokes up, standing proudly on a **podium**.
Lay *two planks* in a box, sprinkle *grass* on top, and the sweet treat inside is **candy**.
A *little fortune stick* is pushed in beside a *post on ground*, telling travellers to halt: a **stop sign**.
Lean a *slide* against a *ski* with a scooped tip, and you have a **spoon**.
Plant a *cross* in the earth and its *curtains* spread down like roots: a **tree**.
Dig a *rice field*, pile *soil* beside it, and soon houses gather around: a **village**.
A *plank* with blades poking up through it, like **grass** pushing through a fence.
Three *heart dots* bounce above a *smile curve*: that is a happy **heart**.
A *bent cross* sits on top of a straight *cross*, axle over wheels: a rolling **cart**.
Climb the *podium*, sing to the *sun*, and the air fills with **music**.
Your *left hand* grips the top while your *ski* leg drags behind: a **crutch**.
A *fish hook* thumb and *two planks* of fingers reach out to you: a **helping hand**.
Under a raised *eyebrow* a *ski* of a tail slides along the floor: a fat **python**.
A *slash* of a leg and a curved *swan* neck hold up a top: a **small table**.
A *lying man* wakes to find a *ski* of a tail coiled beside him, hissing: a **cobra**.
Stand a *pole* upright on a *plank* of ground: a **post on ground**.
Cross one *slide* over another *slide*, squeeze the handles, and snip: a pair of **scissors**.
A *pole* stands between two *curtains* that flutter with feeling: a **standing heart**.
A *seedling top* grows under the *moon* and creeps over every stone as green **moss**.
A *seedling top* pokes out of the earth with a little *slide* of a leaf: a **seedling**.
A *slanted cap* flies over a *big man*'s head as he ducks: an **arrow**.
A *big man* reaches up but bumps a *plank* above him: that plank is the **sky**.
A *pole* is chopped down and the *lid* falls off one side: a **split log**.
Flip an *archway* upside down and sink it into the ground: now it is a deep **pit**.
*Two planks* sit inside a long frame, like the folds of an **ear**.
A *slide* of ants marches over a *cross* in a long line: **thousand ants**.
Lift the *plank* across the doors, the *grass* springs up below: pull the **door bar**.
A *slide* of a horn sticks out from a heavy body chewing grass: a **cow**.
A *bracket* bends over a sleeping shape and a *slide* tucks it in: a **blanket**.
Under a *cliff* sits a *drop* of a chimney: a small wooden **shed**.
Tie a *plank* across the bottom of a *tree* to show where it grips the earth: its **roots**.
Draw a *plank* line on the pitch and put a *stop sign* behind it: the **goal line**.
Your *right hand* tugs and peels the skin off an animal: its **hide**.
A *shelf bracket* juts out from the rock face high above the sea: a steep **cliff**.
Put a *plank* seat on top of two long *legs*: a **tall stool**.
*Thousand ants* march out of an open *mouth*, riding along on a long pink **tongue**.
A *person* stands with arms out over a *plank* of floor, holding up the canvas of a **tent**.
Swing a *scythe*, rest it on a *plank*, and a *drop* of string ties it back: a **tethered arrow**.
Lift the *lid* and lines of words pour out, rising in a big **speech bubble**.
Weave *grass* together and close the bottom with a *plank*: a sturdy **grass basket**.
A *drop* of water freezes, then another, hanging from the gutter as **icicles**.
A *bent knife* of a mouth opens over a *person*, who stretches out a huge **yawn**.
A *slide* of rope slung over a *scholar*'s shoulders carries two buckets on a **shoulder pole**.
Hang a cloth over an *archway* and pin a *pole* down the middle: a hanging **towel**.
An *archway* with rungs inside, dipped down the well to bring up water: a **bucket**.
A *ski* cuts across a *plank* and bends at the bottom: a **bent cross**.
Stand a *cross* on a long *plank* desk and study beneath it all night: a **scholar**.
A *bent wire* loops round and a *slash* trails down from it: a curled **ribbon**.
Under an *archway* of shell a tiny *person* hides, safe inside the **shell**.
A *bent knife* tip grows out of a *bucket* of bone: the curved **ox horn**.
A *right hand* drags a *slide* of a foot behind it: tired **trudging feet**.
Unwind a *cocoon*, gather up the *crumbs* of fluff, and spin them into a **silk skein**.
An *awning* shades a *shell* pressed flat and dried: the first **page** of a book.
Push a *pole* straight down through the *sun* to roast it on a **skewer**.
Shake a *tree* until its grains fly out like little *horns* in every direction: **rice**.
A *pole* of a back bends into a *bracket* at the knees: a **kneeling man**.
